title: Observational Sketches
content: Pencil sketches from observational drawing sessions — people in casual poses, a classmate at work, dogs and other animals drawn from life. All black and white, all done from direct observation.

images.caption: Focused Individual at Work: A classmate bent over their work, sketched from across the room.

images.alt: Collection of pencil studies of people in casual poses, seated, standing and leaning
images.caption: Studies of Human Figures: Quick studies of people in casual poses — seated, standing, leaning. Drawn from observation, minimal detail.

images.alt: Collection of pencil sketches of one dog, a frontal portrait and several resting poses
images.caption: Dog Portraits and Postures: A few sketches of the same dog — frontal portrait and a couple of resting poses.

images.alt: Collection of pencil sketches of animals, including rodents, rabbits, birds, monkeys and dogs
images.caption: Diverse Animal Studies: Rodents, rabbits, birds, monkeys, dogs — each drawn in whatever pose they happened to be in.
